title: Certifications and practice
blurb: University formats, the one badge we could verify, dated versions, and answers that keep their gaps.
summary: No invented exam codes. The sales badge is a sales badge. Date every number.

lessons.title: University is a catalog, not a secret exam code
objectives: Say that assessments exist without inventing a code
paragraphs: Five9 University is the public training front door: online classes, webinars, instructor-led classes, train-the-trainer, and custom programs. The curriculum brief this lab read is dated April 2023. Treat the mix of courses as a dated brochure.

Administrator classes exist, and the community article says administrator assessments exist. It does not publish an exam code this lab can repeat. If a study guide invents Five9-CA-100 or any cousin, close it.
uncertain: The curriculum brief is from April 2023. Course lists move. This lab found no public administrator exam code to quote.

lessons.title: The badge we could verify is a sales badge
objectives: Do not use it as an admin license
paragraphs: Five9 IVA Sales Certified is a Credly badge. The public badge says five modules and a 20-question final, with a passing mark of 80 percent. The partner blog describes it as a sales certification for partners.
It is not an engineering credential for VCC administration, IVR build, or dialer design. Passing it does not make someone the person who should change Max Abandoned Call Percentage.
uncertain: Badge details were read from the public Credly page and the partner blog. Confirm the current attempt rules before you depend on them.

lessons.title: Practice is the domain, not the badge
objectives: Treat invented codes as a negative signal
paragraphs: The objects you must be able to touch are the ones in the planning topic and the IVR chapter: skill groups, users, lists, dispositions, profiles, campaigns, and modules. A certification that never had you start a stopped inbound campaign did not finish the job.
Use this lab's lessons as the drill. Each one ends in a lab and a fault. The fault log is synthetic. The failure mode is the one the cited page describes.

lessons.title: Version timelines go stale on purpose
objectives: Re-read the PDF before you freeze a standard
paragraphs: Numbers you copy from a PDF are dates, not laws. The technical requirements this lab read named Salesforce managed package 2.46, ServiceNow releases Australia, Zurich, and Yokohama, JRE 8 updates 421, 451, and 461, and macOS 15 Sequoia, 26 Tahoe, and 27 Golden Gate. All of that is an October 2026 reading.
A study plan that memorizes those numbers without a date will be wrong. Write 'as of' or do not write them.
uncertain: Salesforce 2.46, ServiceNow Australia/Zurich/Yokohama, JRE 8 updates 421/451/461, and macOS Sequoia 15, Tahoe 26, and Golden Gate 27 are from the technical requirements read in October 2026.

lessons.title: How to answer without inventing
objectives: Use object, behavior, page, and gap
Prefer a marked unknown to a fake precision
paragraphs: An interview answer in this lab has four beats: the object, the behavior, the page, and the gap. 'A stopped inbound campaign does not answer. The inbound topic says callers hear busy. I have not memorized a numeric abandon default.' That is a complete answer.
The interview deck on this site uses the same links as the lessons. If you cannot say the page, say you do not know. Guessing a port, a percent, or a cert code is a worse answer than silence.

lessons.title: A study week that stays inside the documents
objectives: End each session on the cited page
paragraphs: Six sessions cover the floor without a fake exam. One: planning order and skills. Two: inbound, lists, and the three campaign types. Three: dial modes and the abandon warning, plus the pacing lab. Four: IVR modules and the builder. Five: desktop, CRM, and WEM as neighbors. Six: SIP stories, E911, retention, and one boss incident.
Each session ends by opening the page, not by highlighting this lab. The lab is a door.

lessons.title: What this lab will not pretend to be
objectives: Keep this lab in the study column
paragraphs: Five9 Lab is an independent study floor. It is not Five9, not a partner portal, and not a place that can change your domain. The builder's JSON is not an import. The pacing chart is not the dialer. The 3D topology is a picture of failure, not a network map of your tenant.
When a fact might have moved, the lesson says uncertain. Your next step is the linked page, then Five9 University if you want an official class. That is the whole honesty policy.
